name: Belzutifan

own_problems.text: Carries a boxed warning in United States — for heart harm and harm to an unborn baby

summary: Belzutifan has a boxed warning in the United States for heart harm and teratogenicity, which means it can cause harm to an unborn baby [3]. A small computer model, not tests on people, gave this medicine a high score of 74 for liver risk [M]. The same computer model gave the drug a low score of 40 for heart risk [M].
